title: Family, piano, and first bands heard
summary: No one else in his family played; his first instrument was piano, which he had at home. He recalls the first Dixieland band he heard, with Lib Newton on bass, who started him on bass in 1910, and lists its members.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Can you tell me about the first music you ever heard? Were your parents musical? Did they play anything?
Yeah, no, no one played but me. No one played but me. I was the only one that was a musician.
What was the first instrument you ever took up?
Piano.
Piano. Did you have a piano at home or have to practice on the neighborhood?
No, I had it home.
How did you come right here? You had a fidget, huh? What was some of the first music you ever heard? The first bands or where did you hear music?
Oh, I got to go back to the way. Dixieland, I heard the first was played by the Olympic band, I think. And that was...
Do you remember who was in the band?
Yeah, they had... Yeah, they had... Lib Newton... And...
A deep play? Let me stop. Oh.
No, that wasn't the right name, but...
The Olympic... It wasn't the Olympic band.
It wasn't the Olympic band. Who was in it though? They had Lib Newton...
A deep play?
He played bass fiddle. He's the one who started me on bass. It was 19... 12... 1910. And...
Who else was in the band?

Uh... The Lib was on bass and Nene was on drum. And... Tick Chambers was uh... Playing trumpet. And uh... Yank was playing trombone. And uh... Oh... Emmet was playing guitar. And... Let's see... Uh... Who else? Oh... Freddie... Freddie Kepard... Playing... Playing uh... Cornet or... Cornet or...
Cornet or...
Cornet I think it was. Cornet. One of those old time deals. And uh... Let's see who else we had there. I call uh... Carl Yank... Yeah.
Yeah.
That's about all.
Clarinet.
Who was the Clarinet? Clarinet. Yes. They had, they had Ishmann Turo was playing uh... Clarinet. No alto valve, I mean that's...
Alto horn. Alto horn, yeah. That was a dance band or was it?
Yeah, dance band. Yeah.
